data.title: 花火 · 灯下给结尾加一只兔子
data.description: 花火坐在桌边，把几张画了动作的小纸卡摊成一排。她抬起手对着台灯，让墙上的影子竖起两只兔耳，又转了转手腕给影子补了一次鞠躬。暗红真丝睡裙软软落在椅边，手和影子都在灯的光圈里。
data.location: 旅店起居室，桌灯侧面的浅色墙边
data.action: 坐着抬手对灯做兔子手影
data.lighting: 桌灯暖光投出单一清晰的手影，室内其余部分在暗处
data.camera: 侧面中景，同时框住手和墙上的影子
data.promptProse: Sparkle sits at the table in her fully opaque crimson silk nightgown, arranging small cards showing poses in a row. She raises a hand into the desk lamp beam until its shadow grows two rabbit ears on the wall, then tips her wrist and gives the shadow a tiny bow.
data.animaCaption: The hand shadow has clear rabbit ears and her other hand rests on the spread of cards.
